description: Measure current rendered JPEG previews for up to 20 photos; results by photo_id, failures as failed, photos not started within 20 s as remaining. histogram: 64 normalized Rec.709 luma bins (0-255, four levels/bin); mean_luminance same scale; shadow_fraction <=1, highlight_fraction >=254. sharpness: four-neighbor Laplacian variance after area resampling to 512px long edge (enlarges small previews); higher=sharper. These measure JPEG previews, not raw clipping/full-resolution focus. The photo open in Develop gets no thumbnail, since Lightroom's thumbnail there can be stale or an enlarged low-resolution copy: it fails at once, naming render_photo; for that photo take one look before editing and one after, not one per step. Catalog unchanged.

photo_ids.description: Between 1 and 20 photo IDs or file paths, in result order
